summary: A Yes vote increases the City of Westminster transient occupancy (hotel) tax from 8% to 12%.

tax.text: A yes vote supports increasing Westminster's transient occupancy tax from 8% to 12%, generating an estimated $452,000 annually for city services.
tax.quote: A measure to increase the TOT rate to 12% from the existing 8% rate would be estimated to generate approximately $452 thousand.
